title: A Perturbed q-Tsallis Self-Concordant Barrier for Spectrally Robust Semidefinite Programming
summary: We introduce and analyse a perturbed $q$-Tsallis barrier for semidefinite programming (SDP), defined as a spectral perturbation of the classical log-det barrier on the cone of positive definite matrices. The barrier introduces eigenvalue-adaptive stiffening through a Tsallis-type matrix-power term controlled by parameters $q>1$ and $η\geq0$. Our main theoretical contribution is a sharp characterisation of the differential self-concordance regime of the barrier.
